name: dotpath
description: Secret-safe public dotfiles starter for agentic dev workflows.

scripts.check:syntax: bash -n scripts/validate.sh && find examples scripts tests/fixtures -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n
scripts.smoke: node bin/dotpath.js --help && node bin/dotpath.js install --dry-run --home tests/fixtures/clean-home
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:secrets && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke && npm run validate

author: Roger Chappel
